## Week 1 · Greedy · Intervals (days 91–97)

### Day 91 — Greedy fundamentals

`Learn` · Pattern: [Greedy](../patterns/greedy.md)

**Goal:** Make locally optimal choices and argue why they are safe.

**Learn / do:**

- Exchange argument: swapping to the greedy choice never hurts
- Sort both sides and match smallest-to-smallest
- Collect every upward price move

## Week 2 · Monotonic Stack / Deque · Prefix Sum · Divide & Conquer (days 98–104)

### Day 98 — Monotonic deque

### Day 100 — Difference arrays & circular sums

`Learn` · Pattern: [Prefix Sum](../patterns/prefix-sum.md)

**Goal:** Apply range updates lazily and handle wrap-around.

- Count split points where left prefix ≥ right remainder
- Circular max = max(Kadane, total − min subarray)
